description: u-maker hooks. PreToolUse: on-edit-guard.js is the side-effect gatekeeper — it asks for explicit user approval before ALREADY-IMPLEMENTED code (git-tracked + clean = committed/shipped) in a u-maker project is modified (Edit/Write/MultiEdit/Bash), so a bug-fix / feature-or-UI fix cannot introduce silent regressions. New files and in-progress (untracked/dirty) files are NOT gated, so forward construction is friction-free. Mode via U_MAKER_EDIT_GATE=off|strict|auto (default auto). Wired directly, NOT through _dispatch.js (which never blocks). PostToolUse: reactive hooks keep dropzone index, doc<->JSON sync, gate loop state, and deploy staleness in sync after file mutations, dispatched through _dispatch.js.
